# Minions.AI — Operational AI Voice & Front-Office Dispatch System

> Minions.AI builds autonomous, sub-1.8s AI voice agents and speed-to-lead automation systems engineered primarily for real estate teams and brokerages, with genuine support for pest control, HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical businesses as secondary verticals.

## Core Capabilities & Performance Benchmarks
- **Voice Answering Latency**: Answers live phone lines in under 1.8 seconds (1–2 rings), 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- **Lead Capture**: Answers buyer and seller leads, listing inquiries and showing requests that would otherwise be lost to voicemail while agents are mid-showing or with another client.
- **Direct CRM & Calendar Integration**: Two-way real-time scheduling with Follow Up Boss, kvCORE, EspoCRM and Google Calendar for real estate; FieldRoutes, PestPac, GorillaDesk, ServiceTitan, Housecall Pro and Jobber for supported field-service verticals.
- **Instant SMS Speed-to-Lead**: Automatically texts back missed calls or disconnected leads in 4 seconds to secure appointments before competitors respond.
- **Qualification Logic**: Checks representation, financing or pre-approval, timeline and motivation before a showing is booked, and refuses questions it must not answer.
- **Deterministic Human Escalation**: Cleanly transfers complex or high-priority inquiries to the assigned agent with complete caller context briefings.

## Live Callable Phone Demo
- **Live Test Line**: +1 (346) 626-4720
- **Demo Scenarios**: Test 24/7 AI call answering, buyer qualification, calendar availability checking, and instant CRM confirmation.

## Pricing Architecture
- **Starter Build**: $1,000 one-time build fee (Rex 24/7 Voice Dispatcher, CRM/Calendar sync, call forwarding, 14-day delivery).
- **Full Crew Build**: $2,000 one-time build fee (Rex + Zip SMS recovery + Pip web concierge + Gia reviews + Otto intake, 21-day delivery).
- **Ongoing Telephony**: Direct carrier wholesale usage via Retell AI / Twilio (~$0.08–$0.14/min) with zero markup and no mandatory monthly retainers.

- **Real Estate Agencies & Brokerages (Primary)**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/real-estate (LPMAMA qualification, 24/7 showing booking, Fair Housing Act compliance, Follow Up Boss)
- **Pest Control, HVAC, Plumbing, Roofing & Electrical**: genuinely supported secondary verticals with no dedicated landing page at present; contact us for these builds.
